text:
Ravi: FYI: pushing private bundle for on‑prem customers in tonight's VPC window (21:30–22:30 UTC). target image: private-installer:release-2.10.0-hotfix1. Small initrd compression tweak + drop optional GPU driver for a subset of customers. Need release lead ack.
Tess: Ack. Sounds safe. Any special packaging notes?
Jorge: Preflight: cosign signature absent on the mirror copy. deploybot will block promotion without it.
deploybot: packaging job #2498 completed; artifacts: private-installer:release-2.10.0-hotfix1, bundle.tar.gz. cosign: MISSING; checksums: sha256 present.
Ravi: Where did signing fail? Is KMS reachable?
Tess: Signer pipeline error: upstream keyserver returned 504 during cosign upload. Retrying now would be best, but we may hit the change window limit.
Jorge: Options: A) backout and re-pin prior release for customer mirrors, reattempt signing off‑window; B) re-run signer now and hold promotions until sig appears; C) promote unsigned to non-prod mirrors only. Thoughts?
Ravi: For customer-facing mirrors we should backout to avoid unsigned artifacts. Non-prod mirrors can take unsigned for integration. Let's backout pins for production mirrors and re-sign later.
Tess: Runbook (short):
1) abort promotion: `deployctl unpin --env=private --image=release-2.10.0-hotfix1`
2) restore previous pin: `./releasectl pin --env=private --image=release-2.10.0 --manifest=man-2.10.0.json`
3) open incident and annotate signer failure + KMS 504
4) requeue signer job off-window and validate cosign TTL before next push
Jorge: I'll execute step 1 & 2 now.
deploybot: unpin job #2501 started. Detected previous pin: release-2.10.0.
deploybot: unpin job #2501 completed @21:42:10 UTC.
Jorge: Pinning previous release back in place...
deploybot: pin job #2502 completed @21:45:00 UTC. Pins restored to release-2.10.0 for production mirrors.
Ravi: Noted. I'll draft a brief release note: "Backout: release-2.10.0-hotfix1 halted due to cosign upload failure. Restored release-2.10.0 for production mirrors. Re-sign and reattempt in next change window after KMS check."
Tess: Requeueing signer: signer job #2503 queued; monitoring KMS latency and signature TTL. If signer fails 2x, escalate to secops.
oncall: Ping me if we hit repeated signer failures; secops will assist with keyserver routing.
Jorge: For transparency, adding checklist to PR: [packaging completed, cosign present, checksums uploaded, pin applied, mirror smoke].
Ravi: Agreed. We'll attempt non-prod mirror rollout with the unsigned artifact so QA can run longer tests. Mirror target: mirror-staging-2.
deploybot: mirror-staging-2 applied unsigned bundle for integration only (no pin). status: applied @21:53:07 UTC.
Tess: Also will verify mirror retention policy so unsigned artifact doesn't get picked up by any auto-promote job.
Ravi: Thanks all. Action items: Jorge (confirm pin + artifacts removed from prod queues), Tess (monitor signer + KMS), I (post incident + update release calendar). Standby for new window scheduling.
